_comment: Lane-registered parity scenario (W1f harness). Merged over oracle/scenarios/scenarios.json by tools/parity_common.py; one file per scenario.

scenarios.name: hello
scenarios.notes: L20's small literal demo world (t_c98a608c). hello.wf pins only MaxSteps 500; the schema defaults decide everything else (InitAgents 180 / MaxAgents 300, WorldSize 100, RecordAll False / RecordFrequency 1000). --Vision False keeps it Tier A: byte-exact model, no retina raster in the loop. The movie is recorded but NOT compared: PORT_SPEC.md declares run/movie.pmv free, and every tier now defaults to ignoring it (t_588c28e1) -- it measured reproducible here (500 steps / 192 agents) but the native sampling path is not pinned to step boundaries, so it is not part of a byte-exact number.
